typography.instructions: Use Nunito with tracking-tight and font-bold to font-black for a friendly, energetic voice. Use DM Sans for readable, clean data in dashboards. AVOID standard corporate fonts like Inter or Roboto to prevent the 'AI-slop' aesthetic. Ensure all typography feels human, slightly rounded, and highly legible.

colors.instructions: Warm, food-themed palette. Avoid generic blues or clinical grays completely. Use #FFFDF7 as the app background to give it a creamy, organic feel. Use vibrant accents for badges, interactive states, and charts. Text should be a warm charcoal (#2D231F), never pure black.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Soft ambient shadows (shadow-lg, shadow-xl) with a hint of warmth (e.g., rgba(232, 93, 4, 0.08)). No sharp edges—use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Use rounded-full for buttons and stat pills.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay on large background areas to make the app feel tactile, hand-crafted, and 'human-made'.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react. Crucial: Set strokeWidth={2.5} or {3} on all icons to give them a chunkier, friendlier, and playful aesthetic (e.g., <Utensils strokeWidth={2.5} />). Do not use emojis.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. gap-6 to gap-8 for grids. Do not cram elements together.
layouts.grids: Use Bento-style asymmetrical layouts for main landing pages (Mess vs. Cafeteria cards). Dashboards should use dense but rounded widget layouts with clear visual hierarchy.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and forms. Center-align hero text, large cards, and empty states.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bold text, vibrant primary or secondary colors. Hover effect: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase. Active effect: scale-95. Floating Action Button (FAB) for 'Report Food' should be large and sticky at bottom-right.
components.cards: White background (bg-white), rounded-3xl, warm soft shadow, border-none or 1px very subtle warm border (border-[#FDEEDC]).
components.badges: Generous padding (px-4 py-1.5), rounded-full, bright background with high-contrast text. Use heavily for stats, shop names, and item breakdowns.
components.charts: Recharts. Use custom tooltips with rounded-2xl styling. Apply the warm color palette (oranges, yellows, greens) to the bars and lines. Hide grid lines or make them very faint (stroke-[#FDEEDC]). Use rounded tops for bar charts if possible.
components.forms: Inputs with rounded-2xl, bg-white, subtle warm border. Thick border on focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E85D04] focus:outline-none). Add dynamic fields for 'Add Another Item'.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out for hover effects, transition-colors duration-200 for state changes.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for cafeteria shop cards and dashboard widgets (using framer-motion or CSS animations).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over orange/yellow backgrounds meets APCA guidelines. Use dark brown/charcoal text over warm colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid="report-food-fab", data-testid="login-submit-btn").

mess_card.description: Grand college dining hall, used for the main Mess card on the landing page.

cafeteria_card.description: Cafeteria food counter, used for the main Cafeteria shops card.

shop_placeholder.description: Fresh juice and snacks, use as a placeholder for cafeteria shop covers (Amul Shop, Nescafe, etc.).

waste_aesthetic.description: Aesthetic organic orange peels, use for empty states, login page backgrounds, or the student feedback flow.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'LeftoverLab' warm color palette. Do NOT use default Tailwind grays, blues, or indigos (e.g., slate, blue, gray). Use the defined warm charcoal (#2D231F) for all text to ensure it looks human-made and appetizing.
Implement a highly visible Floating Action Button (FAB) on the main user landing page for 'Report / Rate Food'.
Build the dashboard metrics and charts using Recharts. Ensure the charts use the primary/secondary warm colors (orange, yellow, green, red) and remove rigid, dark grid lines.
Implement the anonymous student feedback flow with a chunky, interactive 1-5 star rating component. Use Lucide icons (Star) with fill and strokeWidth={2.5}.
Ensure all cards have a large border-radius (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl) to maintain the playful, non-corporate vibe.
The data entry form for waste tracking must dynamically allow adding multiple items (e.g., 'Rice - 5kg') before submitting (use a repeating field array or local state array).
Implement mock data logic for the Mess dashboard to toggle between Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and 'Sunday Brunch'.
Create 6 distinct shop cards for the Cafeteria landing (Amul Shop, Campus Zaiqa, Nescafe, Hungrys, Friend's Juice Corner, Snacks Point) using mock stats.
Avoid Shadcn defaults where they look too rigid or 'Vercel-like'. Customize the border-radius and strip away the subtle gray borders in favor of soft warm shadows and warm border colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, ensuring warm background tints.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the CSS file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped with interaction animations and colors relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
